title: Practice: an agent loop that is driven by the stop reason (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a run alternates model and tools until the model ends its turn
cases.says: A run alternates model and tools until the model ends its turn, and the model sees the growing conversation

cases.id: e1 the stop reason decides and the words of the text do not
cases.says: The stop reason decides: a reply that says "done" but calls a tool continues, and one that announces a tool but ends its turn ends

cases.id: e2 every call of a turn is answered in one user message in order
cases.says: Every call of a turn is answered in one user message, in order, with the assistant turn kept as it came

cases.id: e3 a failing or unknown tool becomes an error result and the run goes on
cases.says: A failing or unknown tool becomes an error result and the run goes on

cases.id: e4 the turn limit is a backstop that ends only a run the model has not ended
cases.says: The turn limit is a backstop: it ends an endless run with its own status and does not cut off a run that ends on the last turn

cases.id: e5 a cut off or refused reply ends the run with its own status
cases.says: A cut-off, refused, stop-sequence or never-seen stop reason ends the run with the right status

cases.id: e6 a tool use reply without a tool call is malformed and sends nothing more
cases.says: A tool_use reply with no tool call is malformed and nothing more is sent
